Bolton, 애스턴 빌라, 아스널 and 리버풀 complete the top seven, while 셰필드 유나이티드, 왓퍼드 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 remain in the relegation zone. Preston have leaped to the top of the Championship, a point ahead of Cardiff, Birmingham and 더비 카운티. 번리 and 스토크 시티 are also challenging for a play-off spot, while 리즈 유나이티드, Hull and Southend are battling relegation.
